name: CHROMEWORKS GhostFrame Stealth Ocular Mk3
description:
The GhostFrame Mk3 is Chromeworks' precision stealth ocular platform, designed to pass as a natural eye under casual inspection while running a suite of covert intelligence functions beneath an organic-mimicry surface layer. Passive continuous recording at 4K operates behind a lens that cycles through naturalistic iris micromovement patterns to defeat biometric eye-scanning systems, while an integrated facial recognition scrambler projects subtle infrared interference to confuse camera arrays in the operator's field of view. Low-light amplification runs to 0.0005 lux without pupil dilation, preserving the natural-eye appearance even in near-darkness.

GhostFrame units are the preferred ocular for corporate intelligence operatives, high-end fixers, and anyone whose job requires looking unremarkable while missing nothing. Chromeworks markets them through licensed security channels but the gray market is substantial—their near-perfect cosmetic mimicry makes them uniquely valuable to anyone who needs to pass a biometric checkpoint while running active surveillance.
installation_requirements: Licensed ocular surgeon with Chromeworks certification; 3-hour procedure; post-install biometric calibration session required
rejection_risk: Low — Chromeworks' premium neural integration housing minimizes immune response; organic-mimicry surface layer requires 6-week tissue integration period
maintenance: Chromeworks encrypted firmware updates monthly; lens surface recalibration every 12 months to maintain biometric mimicry accuracy

side_effects: Facial recognition scrambler occasionally interferes with the user's own building access credentials
Continuous recording mode creates psychological hypervigilance in some users — documented cases of inability to stop mentally cataloguing environments
Biometric mimicry cycling causes subtle visual shimmer visible to other GhostFrame wearers
Extended low-light amplification use degrades tolerance for bright environments over time
cultural_context: The GhostFrame Mk3's reputation in Meridian's intelligence community is built on a single quality: nobody can tell you're wearing it. In a city saturated with visible augmentation, the most dangerous eyes are the ones that look human, and Chromeworks has built a quiet empire on that principle. Licensed units are traceable; the gray-market ones are not, and that distinction matters enormously to the people who want them most.
known_users: Undercover law enforcement and private investigators
Organized crime leadership requiring discreet surveillance capability
story_hooks: Someone is selling GhostFrame Mk3 units pre-loaded with a passive data siphon that uploads recordings to an unknown server — the buyers have no idea they're being harvested
A player needs to pass a Tier 5 biometric checkpoint, and the only available GhostFrame unit is registered to a dead corporate operative whose identity is still active in the system
Chromeworks has quietly pushed a firmware update that flags certain facial recognition targets for automatic alert to an unknown third party — someone needs to know who's on that list
